theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_vdb_liminf_bound_ae_of_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (N C : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (ν : ℕ → Measure (Euclidean N)) (W : Set (Euclidean N)) (r : ℝ), (∀ (A : Set (Euclidean N)) (i : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ σ < r ∧ μ (closedBall x σ) ≤ t * ν i (closedBall x σ)) → μ A ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * t * ν i (thickening r A)) → ⨆ i, ν i (thickening r W) ≠ ∞ → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ W → ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r → liminf (fun i ↦ ν i (closedBall x ρ)) atTop ≤ (c : ℝ≥0∞) * μ (closedBall x ρ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
